paragraph: I'm waiting for my girlfriend here at the **terminal**. We met them by accident at the bus **terminal**. Please stay seated until we reach the **terminal**.
english: a building at an airport or station; also causing death

paragraph: A **patent** right is an important property right. A **patent** attorney is a type of lawyer specializing in intellectual property. We're going to make a lot of money from those **patents**.
english: an official document granting an appointment, privilege, or right, or some property or title

paragraph: What do you want your **legacy** to be? What kind of **legacy** do you hope to leave behind? The money is a **legacy** from my aunt.
english: money or property bequeathed to someone in a will

paragraph: The **runner** jumped over the hole in the ground. They will catch up with the lead **runner** soon. Are you the **runner** who escaped the underground city?
english: agent noun of run

paragraph: Embracing differences can **strengthen** our respect for each other. She's exercising in order to **strengthen** her legs. It is very important to **strengthen** the foundations.
english: to make strong or stronger

paragraph: I don't think this chain will stand the **strain**. The **strain** has begun to tell on his health. You'll **strain** your eyes trying to read in this light.
english: a particular variety of a microbe, virus, or other organism, usually a taxonomically infraspecific one

paragraph: Never drive faster than your **guardian** angel can fly. For lots of reasons, I recommended her as your **guardian**. Minors must have a parent or **guardian** sign the form.
english: someone who guards, watches over, or protects

paragraph: It helps improve focus and **concentration** throughout the day. This next part is crucial and requires deep **concentration**. Do one single task at a time with full **concentration**.
english: the act, process or ability of concentrating

paragraph: We hope that you all will sign this **petition**. We need to get more signatures on this **petition**. Everyone at the meeting signed the **petition**.
english: a formal written application made to a magistrate or court for an order or a suit for divorce

paragraph: Do you have a belt that matches this **outfit**? That **outfit** is running a fly-by-night operation. I threw together this **outfit** at the last minute.
english: a set of clothing (with accessories)

paragraph: Do not laugh at the weak-minded and the **disabled**. I'm **disabled**, but I do work off and on. It's hard to imagine myself being **disabled** one day.
english: to stop something from working
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تضحك على الأبله و المعوق.

paragraph: As of tonight, I am no longer a **virgin**. If it never happened to you, you're a **virgin**. Do you really think that she is a **virgin**?
english: a person who has never had sexual intercourse, or (uncommonly) an animal that has never mated

paragraph: He was the one who got the worst **punishment**. I got the **punishment** I deserved. I'm totally against capital **punishment**.
english: act of punishing
arabicDesc: مثال: هو من تلقى العقاب الأكبر.

paragraph: I want to maintain a **barrier** around my heart. For a friend, seven miles is no **barrier**. There is no **barrier** between both of us.
english: a structure that bars passage

paragraph: This does not mean that there is no **variation**. There is relatively little **variation** in temperature here. Obviously there are many **variations** between these two extremes.
english: the act of varying

paragraph: He already had a **warrant** for failure to appear. Police can't enter the property without a search **warrant**. We have a **warrant** to search your property.
english: authorization or certification

paragraph: There are very few **brick** houses in this town. He was banging his head against a **brick** wall. I feel like I'm talking to a **brick** wall.
english: a hardened rectangular block of mud, clay etc., used for building

paragraph: This subject is outside the scope of our **inquiry**. He wrote a letter of **inquiry** to his business contact. Every art and every **inquiry** seem to aim at some good.
english: a question; an official investigation

paragraph: The **snake** reared its head. The **snake** was still alive. The **snake** began to move.
english: legless reptile

paragraph: It's easy for him to **compose** a good poem. Please **compose** a draft of the proposal idea. Words aren't necessary to **compose** music that speaks to you.
english: to make something by merging parts

paragraph: I've asked them if they would consider a **compromise**. I hope we can reach some kind of **compromise**. After hours of discussions, we finally reached a **compromise**.
english: the settlement of differences by arbitration or by consent reached by mutual concessions

paragraph: I just want to make sure it's not **poison**. They want to **poison** you with their religious ideas. **Poison** is really just a question of different perspectives.
english: substance harmful to a living organism

other.meaning: To use poison to kill or paralyse (somebody) (verb)

paragraph: He lost a **fortune** in the stock market. I wish **fortune** would come knocking on my door. He had the **fortune** to marry a nice girl.
english: lots of riches
arabicDesc: مثال: ضيع مبلغا معتبرا في سوق البورصة.

paragraph: It is a very popular **destination** for tourists. The journey is more important than the **destination**. The old city is a popular tourist **destination**.
english: the place set for the end of a journey, or to which something is sent

paragraph: In every society, there are conservative and **progressive** elements. I'm known for my independent and **progressive** thinking. He is very **progressive**, not to say radical.
english: one with liberal or progressive political beliefs

paragraph: I was urged to self **isolate** at home today. He wants to **isolate** me from my friends, my family. Maybe you can help us **isolate** the problem.
english: to set apart or cut off from others

paragraph: What's this **scratch** on your face? We are going to start the work from **scratch**. It's nothing to worry about. It's just a **scratch**.
english: to rub a surface with a sharp object, especially by a living creature to remove itching with nails, claws, etc
arabicDesc: مثال: ما هذا الخذش على وجهك؟

paragraph: Ice turns back into water when it **melts**. The sun is **melting** the snow. The ice **melted** in the water.
english: to change (or to be changed) from a solid state to a liquid state, usually by a gradual heat
arabicDesc: مثال: يتحول الجليد إلى ماء عندما يذوب.

paragraph: We lost out to our **rival** in price competition. Our **rival** was an honest, competitive person as well. He got his greatest **rival** arrested before the elections.
english: someone or something with similar claims of quality or distinction as another

paragraph: Whether a fact or not, it is **commonly** believed. What are some foods **commonly** eaten in America? What **commonly** accepted view do you disagree with and why?
english: as a rule

paragraph: You don't need to be so **defensive**. Don't cross your arms. It makes you seem **defensive**. It's unusual for **defensive** players to score many goals.
english: protecting against attack or criticism

paragraph: I had no difficulty **finding** your house. I'm having a very hard time **finding** a job. I'm **finding** it hard to understand what they're saying.
english: something learned from research
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أجد صعوبة في العثور على مكان بيتك.

paragraph: **Hence**, I shall have to stay here. What will become of the world thirty years **hence**? There is no smoke, and **hence** no fire.
english: in the future from now
arabicDesc: مثال: بالتالي، سوف أضطرُ للقاءِ هنا.

paragraph: Managing your time is **increasingly** important. Some time later, they started to feel **increasingly** sad. In recent years electronic computers have become **increasingly** important.
english: more and more
arabicDesc: مثال: تنظيم وقتك أمر في غاية الأهمية.

paragraph: I'm **incredibly** sick of living. I just had something **incredibly** strange happen to me. I am not so **incredibly** comfortable in my skin.
english: extremely
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد سأمت من الحياة إلى أبعد الحدود.

paragraph: How long are you going to stay in **Oxford**? How much time do you intend to stay in **Oxford**? **Oxford** is one of the oldest universities in the world.
english: a city and local government district in Oxfordshire, England, famous for its university

paragraph: The green water is not **suitable** for drinking. I can't think of a **suitable** example. This land is not **suitable** for agriculture.
english: appropriate to a certain occasion
arabicDesc: مثال: المياه الخضراء غير مناسبة للشرب

paragraph: There are at least **thirty** students in our class. He became the company president when he was **thirty**. I got up at six-**thirty** this morning.
english: cardinal number
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك على الأقل ثلاثون طالب في صفنا.

paragraph: The ticket you bought isn't **valid** during peak times. Both sides of an argument aren't always equally **valid**. This ticket is **valid** for two days after purchase.
english: well-grounded or justifiable, pertinent

paragraph: Exercise is **vital** for a dog. Trust is **vital** for resolving conflicts in a relationship. It's **vital** to respect his privacy during this time.
english: relating to or characteristic of life
arabicDesc: مثال: التمرين مهم بالنسبة إلى الكلب.

other.meaning: necessary to the continuation of life

paragraph: His **observation** is sharp, but he says very little. They set up an **observation** station in the desert. There is an **observation** deck on the fourth floor.
english: the act of observing, and the fact of being observed (see observance)

paragraph: These men are the wisest people of the **tribe**. Members of the **tribe** settled down along the river. The bee **tribe** is as busy as a bee.
english: a tribal nation or people

paragraph: Violence against women is one of the most frequent **violations** of human rights worldwide. Marriage is a type of human rights **violation**. They said it was a clear **violation** of international law.
english: the act or an instance of violating or the condition of being violated
arabicDesc: مثال: العنف ضد النساء هو أحد أكثر اختراقات حقوق الإنسان تكراراً حول العالم.

paragraph: The **railroad** workers are going on strike tomorrow. A line of cars waited at the **railroad** crossing. The cost of building the **railroad** was very high.
english: a track for trains; the train system
arabicDesc: مثال: عمال السكك الحديدية سيضربون عن العمل غداً.

paragraph: The **portrait** shows the profile of a beautiful woman. The artist carefully sketched the outline of the **portrait**. The **portrait** looks exactly like the real thing.
english: a painting or other picture of a person, especially the head and shoulders

paragraph: I can't play the **organ**. I want to learn how to play the **organ**. The skin is the largest **organ** of the body.
english: musical instrument
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أستطيع أن أعزف الأرغن.

paragraph: You must quit smoking **cigarettes**. Thank you for burning my shirt with your **cigarette**. I just lit the wrong end of a **cigarette**.
english: thin roll of tobacco made for smoking
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تقلع عن التدخين.

paragraph: I did that without **consulting** anyone. Why didn't you **consult** me before taking this decision? You had better **consult** a doctor about your health.
english: ask advice
arabicDesc: مثال: فعلتُ ذلك دون استشارة أحد.

paragraph: I don't want to **resign** my job at present. The mayor will shortly announce his decision to **resign**. There are plenty enough reasons for me to **resign**.
english: to give up

paragraph: State **intervention** isn't always the solution to the problem. We are not equipped for such kind of **intervention**. Preparations for a military **intervention** are in their final stages.
english: the action of intervening

paragraph: How long will it take to **drain** the water? This is an organic **drain** cleaner that uses bacteria. This milk has gone bad. Pour it down the **drain**.
english: a conduit allowing liquid to flow out of an otherwise contained volume

paragraph: She runs a **franchise** of a popular restaurant chain. After the third film, this **franchise** is terrible. The Dragon Quest **franchise** is celebrating its 40-year anniversary in 2026.
english: the right to sell a company's products using its name

paragraph: The speech made by the president yesterday **delighted** his supporters. I **delighted** in going to his farm during the summer vacation. I was **delighted** with the news.
english: something that gives great joy or pleasure
arabicDesc: مثال: أسعد خطابُ الرئيس الذي ألقاه أمس أنصاره.

paragraph: I don't have a **daddy**. **Daddy**, I'll stop doing theater and won't sing anymore. **Daddy**, let's see if you can out-stare me.
english: also used as a term of address: a father

paragraph: You'll have to **lend** me some of your clothes. Why did you **lend** money to someone like her? I will **lend** you money just this once.
english: to allow to be used temporarily
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تعيرني بعض ملابسك.

paragraph: The **transmission** of this truck is completely worn out. Have you ever driven with a standard shift **transmission**? How much do the **transmission** rights come to?
english: sending something; a broadcast; also the gear system of a car

paragraph: The government taxed **luxury** goods at a higher rate. She was brought up in the lap of **luxury**. Happiness is a **luxury** I don't think I can afford.
english: very wealthy and comfortable surroundings

other.meaning: something pleasant but not necessary in life

paragraph: The religion was in its **glory** in those days. You can't appreciate the flies in all their **glory**. We ran for the **glory** of the school.
english: great beauty and splendor

paragraph: Your **remarks** are besides the point. I don't like these **remarks**. His **remark** has nothing to do with the subject.
english: an act of pointing out or noticing

paragraph: Despite his **mature** way of speaking, he is just a nine-year-old. You need to grow up and **mature** a bit. I thought we could discuss this like **mature** adults.
english: fully developed
arabicDesc: مثال: على رغم من أسلوبه حديثه الناضج، لكن في الحقيقة هو مجرد طفل بعمر ٩ سنوات.

other.meaning: To proceed toward maturity: full development or completion (either of concrete or of abstract things, e.g. plans, judgments, qualities) (verb)

paragraph: The farmer keeps a **pig**, two cows and some chickens.
english: a farm animal with a flat nose and short legs

paragraph: They are so **tired** that they can't study. Though I was **tired**, I did my best. He said that he was really **tired**.
english: to become sleepy
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يستطيعون الدراسة لأنهم متعبون جدا.

paragraph: I want to **charter** a bus. The **charter** flight is to take off at three. The United Nations **Charter** was signed in 1945.
english: a document issued by some authority, creating a public or private institution, and defining its purposes and privileges

paragraph: How can I desert the **fleet**? The airline has grounded its **fleet**. The Black Sea **Fleet** has disappeared.
english: a group of vessels or vehicles, generally operating in a unified way or traveling together

paragraph: I can't stay in bed for the entire **pregnancy**. It's a **pregnancy** test and it's positive. I need this for a **pregnancy** test.
english: 9-month period of carrying offspring in the uterus
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يمكنني أن أبقى في السّرير طيلة مدّة هذا الحمل.

paragraph: I watch a movie or **documentary** almost every day. He recorded a **documentary** and gave it to me. Change the channel, because this **documentary** is very boring.
english: of, related to or based on documents/that serves to document something

other.meaning: presented objectively without the insertion of fictional matter
A film, TV program, publication etc. which presents a social, political, scientific or historical subject in a factual or informative manner (noun)

paragraph: That's the most beautiful **engagement** ring I've ever seen. I can't go with you. I have an **engagement**. I am very happy to hear about your **engagement**.
english: an appointment, especially to speak or perform

paragraph: Please return one set to us with your **signature**. This is the **signature** dish of the restaurant. All I need is your **signature**, right here.
english: a person's name, written by that person, used as identification or to signify approval of accompanying material, such as a legal contract

paragraph: What should you do if you find a big **spider** on your bed? Birds have nests, **spiders** have webs and people have friendships. Have you ever seen a **spider** making a web?
english: any of various eight-legged, predatory arthropods, of the order Araneae, most of which spin webs to catch prey
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا ينبغي أن تفعل إن وجدت عنكبوتا كبيرا على سريرك؟

paragraph: The economy is based on fishing, tourism and **agriculture**. The **agriculture** sector is small, and most food is imported. The land is no longer fit for **agriculture**.
english: the art or science of cultivating the ground

paragraph: Many small business owners belong to a chamber of **commerce**. Legal changes threaten online sales in digital **commerce**. Advertising is the driving force behind **commerce**.
english: the exchange or buying and selling of commodities

paragraph: This is a writing style different from **genuine** English. Not all **genuine** leather products are of good quality. Would you like a belt made of **genuine** leather?
english: belonging to, or proceeding from the original stock

paragraph: I like adding some **honey** to green tea. I dipped my finger into the **honey**. **Honey** is made by **honey** bees.
english: sweet substance produced by bees
arabicDesc: مثال: أحب إضافة العسل لشاي الأخضر.

other.meaning: term of affection — see also darling

paragraph: I **merely** came to inform you of the fact. Your interpretation is based **merely** on the surface meaning. Don't look down on him **merely** because he is poor.
english: without any other reason etc

paragraph: This is not a vacation, it's a **survival** course! Food, clothing and shelter are the foundations of **survival**. Is there enough food for **survival** on the island?
english: continuing to live

paragraph: They want to see the entire **regime** collapsing. Even the most loyal are never safe from the **regime**. Democracy is the worst possible **regime**, except for all the others.
english: mode of rule or management

paragraph: You have to read this **passage** for next week. A car lying on its side blocked the **passage**. I want to sum up this **passage** for you.
english: a paragraph or section of text or music with particular meaning

paragraph: He wanted to punch Mr. **Bean** in the face. Just one **bean** doesn't make you full. I was a **bean** there for good.
english: any plant of several genera of the taxonomic family Fabaceae that produces large edible seeds or edible seedpods

paragraph: They rushed out into the **arena**. He was in the **arena**. The **arena** can be converted quickly from athletic events to concerts, to theater performances.
english: an enclosed area, often outdoor, for the presentation of sporting events (sports arena) or other spectacular events

paragraph: The whole forest was about four hundred **acres**. I bought an eight-**acre** farm for my retirement. You can raise goats on one **acre** of land.
english: any of various similar units of area in other systems
arabicDesc: مثال: تتربع مساحة الغابة على 400 آر.

other.meaning: A state of the North Region, Brazil. Capital: Rio Branco (noun)

paragraph: Do you know how to drive a **manual** car? We'll have to find water with a **manual** pump. The instruction **manual** describes all the particulars of the camera.
english: synonym of handbook
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كتيب التشغيل، كتاب التعليمات

paragraph: The station is well **equipped**. He wants to **equip** his son with a good education. This museum is **equipped** with a fire prevention system.
english: to give someone the tools they need
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت اامحطة مجهزة بشكل جيد.

paragraph: I had to **coordinate** the tasks of twenty people. Don't worry, if that happens, we will just have to **coordinate**! We live our limited life in the **coordinate** system of time and money.
english: a number representing the position of a point along a line, arc, or similar one-dimensional figure

paragraph: I don't even remember how the whole **epic** ended. When he started dating, he experienced many **epic** failures. You can't miss this party, it's going to be **epic**!
english: a series of events considered appropriate to an epic

other.meaning: Of or relating to an epic (adjective)

paragraph: He has a **faculty** for making other people happy. He has the **faculty** to learn languages easily. She has a **faculty** for doing two things at once.
english: the academic staff at schools, colleges, universities or not-for-profit research institutes, as opposed to the students or support staff

paragraph: They brought us over here on a **cruise** ship. The **cruise** missiles were armed and ready to go. Have you ever been on a **cruise** ship?
english: a sea or lake voyage, especially one taken for pleasure

paragraph: The **removal** of the load-bearing beam compromised the structure of the building. You're coming with three **removal** vans? I've got nowhere near that much furniture. I had laser hair **removal**.
english: taking something away

paragraph: Are you more of a leader or a **follower**? I am a **follower** of that school. He's only fifty **followers** away from hitting a million.
english: one who follows, comes after another

paragraph: She's famous as a singer but not as a **poet**. You are made to be a **poet**. Not everybody can be a **poet**.
english: person who writes poems
arabicDesc: مثال: هي مشهورة كمغنية و لكنها ليست معروفةً كشاعرة.

paragraph: Happiness doesn't lie in insight, but in its **acquisition**. The **acquisition** of wealth does not interest me. This is the latest **acquisition** to my library.
english: the act or process of acquiring

paragraph: Is it still worth it to become an **intellectual**? I've never been an **intellectual** but I have this look. Besides being beautiful, she is kind and **intellectual**.
english: relating to the mind and thinking

paragraph: This has been a messed up **scenario** all around. Plan for the **scenario** where things don't work out. The same **scenario** played out twice in a row.
english: an outline or model of an expected or supposed sequence of events

paragraph: She says she wants to buy a **drum** set. I couldn't afford to get you a new **drum**. He gave a **drum** set to his son.
english: a percussive musical instrument spanned with a thin covering on at least one end for striking, forming an acoustic chamber

paragraph: Please give each other a **hug**. She **hugged** him while he cried. I just want to give you a big **hug**.
english: affectionate embrace

paragraph: You don't need to **panic**. We **panicked** a little bit. The police didn't really want to create a **panic**.
english: overwhelming fear or fright; an instance of this

paragraph: The city was filled with **ash** and abandoned vehicles. After the fire, there was a lot of **ash**. **Ash** Wednesday is the first day of Lent.
english: solid remains of a fire

paragraph: I want to hire a **servant**. Money is a good **servant**, but a bad master. He has only one **servant** to attend on him.
english: one who is hired to perform regular household or other duties, and receives compensation

paragraph: Random assignment to a study group eliminates selection **bias**. The researchers failed to account for observation **bias**. You have to judge the case without **bias**.
english: inclination towards something

paragraph: I want to know the reason for his **absence**. No one noticed her **absence** until the meeting ended. After an **absence** of ten months, he returned home.
english: a state of being away or withdrawn from a place or from companionship

paragraph: The tip of the knife **blade** is sharp. The **blade** stops when it comes into contact with skin. I received a knife with a sharp **blade**.
english: the (typically sharp-edged) part of a knife, sword, razor, or other tool with which it cuts
